Step-by-Step Audio Guided Tour: restaurant tour of Buttermilk & Bourbon - Back Bay, Boston, MA
Tour-Category: restaurant

Stop 1: Buttermilk & Bourbon

Address: 2 Berkeley St, Boston, MA 02116

Coordinates: 42.3493, -71.0675

Orientation: You are about to embark on a walking journey through Buttermilk & Bourbon - Back Bay, Boston, MA. Immerse yourself in the single stop, Buttermilk & Bourbon, where celebrity blue-haired Chef Jason Santos has blended Southern cuisine traditions with innovative reinvention since debuting the restaurant in 2017. Discover how Chef Jason Santos's culinary exploration led to the creation of this vibrant culinary destination, which expanded to a new-build location in Watertown's Arsenal Yards four years later. Your first stop is Buttermilk & Bourbon. This New Orleans-inspired restaurant is the creation of Chef Jason Santos, a notable figure in the culinary world who brings his electric blue hair and vibrant culinary flair to Boston.

Buttermilk & Bourbon offers more than just dining; it provides an experience rich in Southern hospitality with a touch of modern mishap. During the restaurant's early days, a malfunctioning slush machine transformed a typical dinner rush into a surprising spectacle, spraying bourbon-soaked slush across the prep areas. Chef Jason Santos, the celebrity chef known for his blue hair, born on March 1, 1976, has made a name for himself not only for his culinary skills but also for his appearances on television. He was a runner-up on Season 7 of " the Kitchen" and later served as Gordon Ramsay's sous-chef for several seasons. His deep connection to New Orleans cuisine is evident in every dish, particularly in his creation featuring a whole roasted pig head—an attention-grabbing spectacle that often steals the show in the dining room. The site at 160 Commonwealth Avenue was once the location of the Hotel Vendome, where a tragic disaster in 1972 resulted in the loss of nine firefighters. The history of the site adds a layer of depth to the modern charm of the lively restaurant, Buttermilk & Bourbon. Whether sampling the tapas-style Southern comfort food or simply soaking in the vibrant atmosphere, Buttermilk & Bourbon offers a culinary journey worth experiencing. Operating hours are Monday and Tuesday from 5:00 pm to 10:00 pm, with reservations required. With prices under $30, it provides an accessible yet upscale dining experience that transports you straight to the heart of New Orleans.
